strategies_and_hard_rules.content: Audit trail must be independent from agent access. Agents can write audit events but cannot read, modify, or delete them. Build audit infrastructure as a separate service.

Evaluate features using scaffolding vs tools framework: Scaffolding compensates for weak models (temporary, remove when models improve). Tools provide lasting value regardless of model capability (durable, keep forever).
High-frequency validation: Tests must pass before adding new features. Run validation (tests, lint, types) on every change. Code generation without validation is under-sampling.
Fix lint/type issues incrementally as you touch files, not in big batches. Accept known technical debt, prevent new debt.
Enterprise branch uses PostgreSQL + pgvector for storage. OSS branch uses simple JSON files. Auditing is enterprise-only.

troubleshooting.content: If MCP server returns 'Playbook not found', specify --playbook flag with actual playbook ID from data/playbooks/, or use --playbook-file with a JSON file.

domain_knowledge.content: CGR³ = Context Graph Retrieve-Rank-Reason. Pipeline: (1) Retrieve candidates by semantic similarity, (2) Rank by context match (team, project, tech stack), (3) Reason about applicability → verdict: APPLY, ASK_FIRST, or SKIP.
ACE is organizational memory. Claude Code is individual session intelligence. ACE persists patterns across sessions; Claude Code forgets when session ends.
Playbook sections: strategies_and_hard_rules (patterns, decisions), code_snippets (reusable code), troubleshooting (problem→solution), domain_knowledge (concepts, definitions).
